feeding behaviour is moderately to highly herited, that genetic correlations between feeding behaviour and production traits are moderate to high, and that there is a low to high range of genetic correlations between feeder preference and feeding behaviour.

the genetic correlations between feeding behaviour and production traits are low to moderate, which suggests that genetic selection for feed efficiency will not have a major effect on feeding behaviours.

feeding behaviours can be clearly defined by calculating meal criterion, there are differences in mean meal characteristics between sire and dam lines and there are genetic correlations between feeding behaviour and production traits.

the genetic analysis of feed intake and feeding behaviour data collected from commercial turkeys.
the genetic and phenotypic variation of feeding behaviours in commercial turkeys.
the genetic and phenotypic analysis of feeding behaviours in group housed turkeys.
